mapper.select: -- 이미 예약된 작업은 고정된 게시/퇴역 정책을 사용한다. 초안이나 다른 release는 거부한다. SELECT policy_hash FROM announcement_attachment_policies WHERE id=#{policyId} AND rule_release_id=#{releaseId} AND policy_status_code IN ('ACTIVE','RETIRED')

-- 현재 source와 정확한 base/content/release만 연결한다. 본문 원문은 이 단계에 필요하지 않다. SELECT e.id,e.content_version_id,e.rule_release_id,r.release_code,r.rule_snapshot_hash,c.raw_hash, s.provider_code,s.agency_name,e.decision_status_code,e.reason_code,e.title_stage_code,e.body_stage_code, e.body_source_code,e.body_availability_code FROM announcement_source_classification_evaluations e JOIN announcement_source_snapshots s ON s.id=e.source_id JOIN announcement_source_content_versions c ON c.id=e.content_version_id AND c.source_id=e.source_id JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases r ON r.id=e.rule_release_id WHERE e.id=#{evaluationId} AND e.source_id=#{sourceId} AND e.is_current

-- 현재 조회 시점이 아닌 지정한 불변 base 평가의 자동 태그를 읽는다. SELECT c.category_code FROM announcement_source_classification_target_matches m JOIN announcement_target_categories c ON c.id=m.target_category_id WHERE m.evaluation_id=#{evaluationId} ORDER BY c.category_code

-- base 입력에 사용된 지원형태를 고정한다. SELECT c.support_type_code FROM announcement_source_classification_support_matches m JOIN announcement_support_types c ON c.id=m.support_type_id WHERE m.evaluation_id=#{evaluationId} ORDER BY c.support_type_code

-- 봉인된 동일 source/set의 최대 10개 파일만 내부 분류기에 전달한다. 표시명은 분류 입력이 아니다. SELECT f.id,x.id AS extraction_id,f.document_role_code,f.download_status_code,x.quality_code, x.extracted_text,x.blocks_json::text AS blocks_json,coalesce(f.error_code,x.error_code) AS error_code,f.role_origin_code FROM announcement_source_attachment_files f JOIN announcement_source_attachment_sets s ON s.id=f.set_id AND s.source_id=f.source_id AND s.set_status_code='SEALED' LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT e.id,e.quality_code,e.extracted_text,e.blocks_json,e.error_code FROM announcement_source_attachment_extractions e WHERE e.file_id=f.id AND e.set_id=f.set_id AND e.source_id=f.source_id ORDER BY e.attempt_no DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) x ON true WHERE f.source_id=#{sourceId} AND f.set_id=#{setId} ORDER BY f.sort_order,f.id LIMIT 11

-- 현재 평가의 입력 FK와 정책 버전에 고정된 분석만 읽는다. 미결합 SHADOW 분석으로 검수 요건을 해제하지 않는다. SELECT i.file_id,i.extraction_id,x.quality_code,x.extracted_text,x.blocks_json::text AS blocks_json, x.page_count,a.analysis_json::text AS analysis_json FROM announcement_source_attachment_evaluations e JOIN announcement_attachment_policies p ON p.id=e.policy_id JOIN announcement_source_attachment_evaluation_inputs i ON i.evaluation_id=e.id AND i.source_id=e.source_id AND i.set_id=e.set_id LEFT JOIN announcement_source_attachment_extractions x ON x.id=i.extraction_id AND x.file_id=i.file_id AND x.set_id=i.set_id AND x.source_id=i.source_id LEFT JOIN announcement_attachment_segment_analyses a ON a.id=i.segment_analysis_id AND a.extraction_id=i.extraction_id AND a.file_id=i.file_id AND a.set_id=i.set_id AND a.source_id=i.source_id AND a.analysis_version=p.settings_json->>'segmentRuleVersion' AND a.rules_hash=p.settings_json->>'segmentRulesHash' WHERE e.id=#{evaluationId} AND e.source_id=#{sourceId} AND e.is_current AND e.engine_version='attachment-segment-1.0.0' AND p.settings_json->>'engineVersion'=e.engine_version ORDER BY i.file_id LIMIT 11

-- 완료한 동일 소유자의 재호출만 멱등 응답하며 구 lease 결과는 반환하지 않는다. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j JOIN announcement_source_attachment_evaluations e ON e.id=j.preview_evaluation_id AND e.source_id=j.source_id WHERE j.id=#{jobId} AND j.lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND j.job_status_code IN ('SUCCEEDED','PARTIAL_FAILED')
mapper.insert: -- 판정은 우선 비현재 이력으로 저장한 후 source CAS와 함께 current로 전환한다. INSERT INTO announcement_source_attachment_evaluations (id,source_id,content_version_id,base_evaluation_id,set_id,policy_id,rule_release_id, engine_version,input_hash,decision_hash,decision_status_code,reason_code,warning_codes_json,is_current) VALUES (#{id},#{sourceId},#{contentVersionId},#{baseEvaluationId},#{setId},#{policyId},#{ruleReleaseId}, #{engineVersion},#{inputHash},#{decisionHash},#{status},#{reason},CAST(#{warningsJson} AS jsonb),false)

-- 실패 파일도 평가 입력에서 빠뜨리지 않는다. INSERT INTO announcement_source_attachment_evaluation_inputs (evaluation_id,source_id,set_id,file_id,extraction_id,document_role_code,input_status_code,segment_analysis_id) VALUES (#{evaluationId},#{sourceId},#{setId},#{fileId},#{extractionId},#{role},#{inputStatus},#{segmentAnalysisId})

-- 저장된 release/group/rule/term을 정확히 해석한다. 일치 원문은 감사 테이블에 복사하지 않는다. INSERT INTO announcement_source_attachment_matches (evaluation_id,source_id,set_id,file_id,extraction_id,rule_release_id,keyword_group_id,keyword_rule_id,keyword_term_id, block_index,start_offset,end_offset,applied_action_code,segment_analysis_id,segment_index) SELECT #{evaluationId},#{sourceId},#{setId},#{fileId},#{extractionId},g.release_id,g.id,r.id,t.id, #{blockIndex},#{startOffset},#{endOffset},#{action},#{segmentAnalysisId},#{segmentIndex} FROM announcement_source_classification_rule_groups g JOIN announcement_source_classification_keyword_rules r ON r.group_id=g.id JOIN announcement_source_classification_keyword_terms t ON t.keyword_rule_id=r.id AND t.group_id=g.id WHERE g.release_id=#{releaseId} AND g.group_code=#{groupCode} AND r.rule_code=#{ruleCode} AND t.term_text=#{termText}

-- 비활성 카탈로그를 신규 자동 태그에 사용하지 않는다. INSERT INTO announcement_source_attachment_tags(evaluation_id,target_category_id,origin_code) SELECT #{evaluationId},id,'AUTO' FROM announcement_target_categories WHERE category_code=#{code} AND is_enabled

-- 복수 지원형태를 자동 근거로 분리 저장한다. INSERT INTO announcement_source_attachment_tags(evaluation_id,support_type_id,origin_code) SELECT #{evaluationId},id,'AUTO' FROM announcement_support_types WHERE support_type_code=#{code} AND is_enabled
mapper.update: -- source 잠금 아래 current 유일성을 유지한다. UPDATE announcement_source_attachment_evaluations SET is_current=false WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND is_current
-- 새 판정에는 이전 검수 확인을 승계하지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_source_attachment_confirmations SET is_current=false WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND is_current
-- source 포인터와 같은 transaction에서 current를 변경한다. UPDATE announcement_source_attachment_evaluations SET is_current=true WHERE id=#{evaluationId} AND source_id=#{sourceId}

-- base/검수 요구/정책은 바꾸지 않는다. COLLECT_ONLY에서도 별도 첨부 preview 포인터만 갱신한다. UPDATE announcement_source_snapshots SET current_attachment_evaluation_id=#{evaluationId}, attachment_row_version=attachment_row_version+1 WHERE id=#{sourceId} AND classification_row_version=#{sourceVersion} AND attachment_row_version=#{attachmentVersion}

-- 마지막 lease fence가 실패하면 근거 판정 쓰기 전체가 rollback된다. token은 멱등 응답용으로만 남긴다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs SET job_status_code=#{jobStatus},preview_evaluation_id=#{evaluationId}, preview_hash=#{previewHash},lease_expires_at=NULL,next_attempt_at=NULL,error_code=NULL, applied_evaluation_id=CASE WHEN batch_id IS NULL AND application_status_code='PENDING' THEN #{evaluationId} ELSE applied_evaluation_id END, applied_attachment_version=CASE WHEN batch_id IS NULL AND application_status_code='PENDING' THEN expected_attachment_version+1 ELSE applied_attachment_version END, applied_source_version=CASE WHEN batch_id IS NULL AND application_status_code='PENDING' THEN expected_source_version ELSE applied_source_version END, applied_input_hash=CASE WHEN batch_id IS NULL AND application_status_code='PENDING' THEN attachment_normal_job_application_hash(id,#{evaluationId}) ELSE applied_input_hash END, application_status_code=CASE WHEN batch_id IS NULL AND application_status_code='PENDING' THEN 'APPLIED' ELSE application_status_code END, row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{jobId} AND lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND job_status_code='RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
